title: Probate Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive
Bristol - Hybrid (2-3 days in office)

I'm keen to speak with experienced Sales Executives who have knowledge of Probate to join a growing team in central Bristol.

You will be the initial point of contact for a family member who has lost a loved one and needs to engage with a lawyer to conduct their estate administration. You will provide expert probate guidance, understand individual needs and be able to take them through the process from initial enquiry through to quotation and contract signature.

What experience is required?
- Ideally probate experience, including technical knowledge eg grant only estates
- Proven sales experience within probate or professional services
- Confident managing a pipeline
- A natural ability to adapt your sales approach with empathy

What is the role?
- This is a fully desk-based telephone sales role using referred inbound leads
- Discuss the estate and probate service required, prepare a quote, follow up and transfer signed clients to the legal team

What's on offer?
- Competitive full-time salary
- Excellent Bonus scheme - up to 20% paid 1/4ly

If this opportunity sounds of interest, apply now with your CV. If you are keen to understand the role a bit more, please get in touch with Loraine Silvester at G2 Legal.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Do you have an exceptional telesales/sales track record and are looking to progress into a field sales role?

We are recruiting a Bristol-based Sales Executive to cover the South West counties for our client, a market-leading facilities management provider with over 100 employees and £10 million + turnover.

This is a field sales role, so you will predominantly be out meeting clients, with the rest of your time generating opportunities working from home, with 1 day per month in their Birmingham office.

As Sales Executive, your responsibilities will include:
- Generating and following up sales leads.
- Management of sales pipeline.
- Meeting agreed KPI s and targets.
- Maintaining strong client relationships.
- Updating the CRM system accurately with all appropriate KPI s, pipeline, opportunities, and revenue achievement.

Experience Required:
- B2 B or B2 C sales experience as a Telesales or Sales Executive.
- Ability to sell within a competitive environment.
- Strong pipeline management skills.
- Resilient, with confident negotiation skills.
- Ability to adapt your sales technique to suit the client.

As a Sales Executive, you can expect a salary of £27,000 if successful, with on-target earnings of £40k+, and a company car or car allowance, so this is a fantastic opportunity to bolster your earning potential.

If this role would be of interest, please submit your CV in application immediately. They are ready to interview and keen to appoint asap.

Please include your current location on your CV or application. Applications without a location may not be considered. If you are relocating, please state both your current location and your intended relocation area.

title: Communications Account Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Account Executive

Remote London Bristol office access Regional travel

£26,000 to £31,000 DOE Full-time

We're working with an ambitious communications agency looking for an Account Executive to join its growing team.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their communications career who wants to work on interesting, high-profile projects and build experience across PR, public affairs, stakeholder engagement and the built environment.

The role

You'll be involved from research through to delivery, helping to:
- Develop and deliver communications and engagement campaigns
- Research political, community and stakeholder landscapes
- Write content for digital, print and social channels
- Support client meetings, events and stakeholder engagement
- Monitor activity and produce clear reports and updates
- Build strong client relationships and support new business activity

You'll work closely with experienced colleagues, with plenty of opportunity to learn, take ownership and develop your career.

About you

We're looking for someone who is curious, organised and confident communicating with different audiences. You'll enjoy getting stuck into new subjects, be comfortable managing multiple priorities and have a good eye for detail.

You may already have experience in PR, communications with an interest or experience of public affairs, politics or the built environment.

An interest in politics, planning, communities or the built environment would be a bonus.

As the role involves some travel across the region, a full driving licence and access to your own car would be advantageous.

If you're looking for a role where you can make an impact, learn quickly and progress within a growing agency, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Professional Indemnity Account Executive
description:
- Clear Path to Directorship
- Market-leading basic salary, tailored to experience + excellent package
- Bristol Hybrid Working Permanent

A rare opportunity to inherit an established, high-quality book of Professional Indemnity business built over many years within a highly respected Bristol broker with national reach.

This is not a cold-start sales role. You'll step into longstanding client relationships, a trusted team, and a genuine succession opportunity from day one.

The Opportunity

Our client is a leading insurance and risk management adviser to the professional services sector, with an enviable reputation built on specialist knowledge and exceptional client care.

Their Professional Indemnity portfolio spans a diverse range of clients, from ambitious technology, AI and FinTech businesses through to established national accountancy practices, solicitors, architects, surveyors and recruitment consultancies.

An experienced and highly regarded colleague is transitioning after many years building this practice, and the business is now seeking the right individual to take stewardship of that client base. This is an opportunity to inherit trusted relationships, continue their development and ultimately make the specialism your own.

What You'll Be Doing
- Taking ownership of an established Professional Indemnity portfolio with strong, loyal client relationships.
- Acting as a trusted adviser to clients across the professional services sector, ranging from SMEs through to large national firms.
- Managing the full client lifecycle, including new business, policy management, mid-term adjustments and renewals.
- Working alongside a highly experienced broking team with significant technical expertise and market knowledge.
- Growing the portfolio through referrals, networking, relationship development and your own profile within the professional services community.
- Establishing yourself as a recognised Professional Indemnity specialist, both locally and nationally.

The Company

This is a highly regarded independent broker with a genuine culture of support, development and work-life balance. They have a long track record of attracting talented insurance professionals and building successful long-term careers around them.

Their presence within the professional services sector is substantial, both regionally and nationally, and their reputation for client service is exceptional.

For the right individual, this role offers a clear and supported pathway to Director level, backed by genuine commitment from the senior leadership team.

What We're Looking For
- Experience within Professional Indemnity insurance.
- A genuine interest in the professional services sector.
- Strong client relationship and communication skills.
- Commercial awareness and the ability to identify and develop opportunities.
- Ambition to take ownership of a portfolio and continue its growth.
- Progression towards ACII would be welcomed but is not essential. Further professional study is actively supported.

Salary and Benefits
- Market-leading basic salary, tailored to experience.
- Car allowance.
- Bonus structure linked to both the inherited portfolio and new business growth.
- Comprehensive employee benefits package.
- Hybrid working.
- Clear and supported route to Directorship.

How to Apply

To apply, or for a confidential discussion about this opportunity, please contact:

Stephen Mallaband, Cavendish Maine

Reference: SM/86741

Candidate Care

By responding to this advert, you consent to Cavendish Maine processing the personal data included within your application. Successful applicants will normally be contacted within 72 hours. If you do not hear from us within three working days, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. We may retain your details for up to six months for suitable future opportunities.

Thank you for your interest in Cavendish Maine.
